mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5pp does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past three months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the past month signals strengthening supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized, the combination signals a potential overheating economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent economic overheating.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decline by more than 100,000 in the past month, the combination signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of high UNRATE and declining PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent economic contraction.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in the past two months signals weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST decline > 10% does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown in the housing sector.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% quarter-over-quarter and Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) declines by more than 2% in the past month, the combination signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth < 1% and INDPRO decline > 2%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of low GDPC1 growth and declining INDPRO does not correlate with subsequent economic contraction.
